title: Instructions From the Person You Replaced

scenes.text: There is a note taped under your desk. You wrote it. Handwriting, pressure marks, coffee stain. Yours. The first line says: If you're reading this, I didn't make it.

scenes.text: The six-year-old who believed shadows had intentions. The sixteen-year-old who could survive anything except being seen trying. The twenty-something who mistook exhaustion for ambition.

scenes.text: None of them left. Not exactly. They were compressed into reflexes. Passwords your fingers remember. Songs that bruise before the chorus. Apologies you still rehearse for people who can no longer hear them.

scenes.text: Do one kind thing I would have been too afraid to do.
